lyrics.text:
TITLE: Neon Teeth
ID: 4fca7c9d-1b40-4592-ae0f-bd1a9488a824
URL: https://suno.com/song/4fca7c9d-1b40-4592-ae0f-bd1a9488a824
IMAGE: https://cdn2.suno.ai/5dea956a-dae9-4ae3-bfce-502b4d604aaf.jpeg
CREATED: 2026-06-27T05:05:59.075Z
PLAYS: 36 UPVOTES: 1
TAGS: Uptempo dark alternative club anthem with Tyler's signature emo-trap, melodic rap, pop-punk, and alternative-rock energy. Sexy, dangerous, nocturnal atmosphere with a driving synth-bass pulse, heavy clean 808s, crisp trap drums, sharp claps, electronic percussion, and distorted electric-guitar accen

=== LYRICS (prompt) ===
[Verse 1 — 12 Bars]

I know my type, I know what I like
Sometimes it’s the eyes, sometimes it’s the curves
Nine times outta ten, it’s the shape of her lips
How they pull me under before she says a word
I could walk away, but her hips press into me
She persuades by the way that she sways
I tell myself no while I’m closing the distance
Already hers before the end of the night
Black dress glowing underneath ultraviolet
That smile cuts clean through the smoke and the heat
I know she’s the kind that could fuck up my life
Still I lean in close to those neon teeth

[Chorus — 8 Bars]

You shine like trouble lighting up the dark
One crooked smile and you’re pulling me apart
You look like heaven under ultraviolet
I see the warning, but I lean inside it
Sweet little poison sitting on your lips
You make bad decisions feel like chemistry
I know what you are, still I move in close
Just to feel the bite of those neon teeth

[Verse 2 — 8 Bars]

She moves like the bass was built for her body
One hand on my chest, one drink in her hand
Says she hates love, but she loves being wanted
I tell her I’m different—she knows that I’m damned
Her perfume stays where her fingertips touched me
Her lipstick stains every lie that I make
I swear I’m in control while she pulls me beneath her
And I’m hers before the first light breaks

[Bridge — 4 Bars]

Light in the morning, I’m fast asleep
She’s gone with the rhythm, still trapped in the sheets
No name on my phone, no note by the bed
Just the taste of the words that we never said

[Chorus — 8 Bars]

You shine like trouble lighting up the dark
One crooked smile and you’re pulling me apart
You look like heaven under ultraviolet
I see the warning, but I lean inside it
Sweet little poison sitting on your lips
You make bad decisions feel like chemistry
I know what you are, still I move in close
Just to feel the bite of those neon teeth

[Verse 3 — 8 Bars]

Maybe I stay home ’cause I know she’s out there
Waiting in a room where the blue lights bleed
Maybe I fear how fast I would follow
The first bad angel who looks like my need
But I’m not innocent, I smile when I’m lying
Leave before daylight, disappear clean
I keep looking for monsters wearing red lipstick
While I’m hiding a mouth full of neon teeth

[Final Chorus — 8 Bars]

We shine like trouble lighting up the dark
Two crooked smiles trying to tear us apart
We look like heaven under ultraviolet
We see the warning, but we lean inside it
Sweet little poison sitting on our lips
We make bad decisions feel like chemistry
I know what you are ’cause you’re just like me
Both hiding behind those neon teeth

meaning.story: This song explores a high-stakes, mutual obsession between two people who are drawn to each other’s dangerous allure despite knowing the consequences. The subtext reveals a toxic intimacy where both parties are complicit in their own destruction, symbolized by neon teeth representing the addictive, destructive pull of their connection.
